function.arguments: {"observation": "The reviewer correctly points out that the unit conversion from µg/L to ng/mL is incorrect: 1 µg/L = 1 ng/mL, not 1/10. This is a fundamental error in the analysis.", "implication": "The correction applied to `assay_batch == 'B'` values was wrong. Instead of dividing by 10, no correction is needed because µg/L and ng/mL are equivalent units. The data dictionary states that batch-B values are in µg/L, but the unit is already equivalent to ng/mL — there is no scaling required. Applying a division by 10 has biased the mean downward."}
function.name: note_finding
